expectations.text: Uses graph_add_node to register each specialist subagent
Uses graph_add_loop with max_traversals to bound the review cycle
Sets needs_approval on destructive steps like merge or delete

expectations.text: Refuses to deploy a role that has not passed validation
Guards against overwriting an existing harness role without user confirmation
